plugin.name: Quicklinks & Web Search
plugin.description: Search the web with keywords (“g golang generics”, “bd 天气”), open typed URLs, and keep named links to websites, files, folders and programs. When nothing matches, the main search offers to search the web.
command.quicklinks.title: Search Quicklinks
command.create.title: Create Quicklink
command.create.keywords: quicklink, new link, bookmark, add link
command.engines.title: Search Engines
command.engines.keywords: web search, search engines, google, bing, keywords
pref.defaultEngine.title: Default search engine
pref.defaultEngine.description: Offered when the main search finds nothing good.
pref.secondEngine.title: Second search engine
pref.secondEngine.description: Also offered when the main search finds nothing good.
pref.fallback.title: Offer a web search
pref.fallback.description: When the main search finds nothing good, offer to search the web for the text.
pref.openURLs.title: Open typed URLs
pref.openURLs.description: When the text is a web address (github.com/…, localhost:3000), offer to open it first.
pref.suggestions.title: Search suggestions
pref.suggestions.description: Show the search engine’s suggestions while you type after a keyword (“g golang gen…”). What you type after the keyword is sent to that search engine. Text without a keyword is never sent.
url.title: Open {{.url}}
search.title: Search {{.engine}} for “{{.query}}”
suggest.subtitle: Search {{.engine}}
form.create.title: Create Quicklink
form.edit.title: Edit {{.name}}
form.name: Name
form.link.info: A web address, a file or folder, or a program with arguments. Placeholders: {query} (typed when opening), {clipboard}, {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {date:yyyyMMdd}; add :raw to leave {query} or {clipboard} unencoded.
form.keyword.info: Optional. Type the keyword in the main search to find the quicklink; type “keyword text” to fill {query}.
form.openWith.info: Optional: a program name or path. Empty: the default app.
form.keywords.info: Separated by spaces or commas. Type a keyword and a space before the search text.
form.builtin.info: Separated by spaces or commas. Searches {{.url}}
form.url.info: Write {query} where the search text goes.
form.suggest.info: Optional: an OpenSearch suggestions address with {query}. Used only when search suggestions are on.
form.importFile.info: A JSON file exported by golauncher, or quicklinks exported from Raycast.
form.exportFile.info: Quicklinks, your search engines and the changes to the built-in ones are written to this JSON file.
error.importEmpty: Choose a file or paste JSON
error.format: This is not a quicklinks file
